title: Issue #1939 execution
intent: Draft PR #4197 open and CI-green; waiting on PR #4185 to land so the burst rule can be rebased into its queue model
progress_summary: SPEC #1939 Phase 71 T-IDX-436/437 delivered as Draft PR #4197 (commit 3de8bf643). search-multi's query encode now claims the host-wide heavy lease at interactive priority (it previously took none at all, so AS-30's one-runner-tree rule was untrue and a search could never preempt a background build); the interactive exemption is bounded by heavy.burst.json to stop searches starving background work; and the v2 canonical-base/overlay build - the path production search uses - now checkpoints every 16 documents, yields, and resumes from the Embedding CAS. My own test caught a livelock in the first burst design (one-sided stand-aside) and a latent trap in sweep_live_registrations_excluding, both fixed. CI green on 3de8bf643: Test (Rust), Test (Rust, Windows), Test (Python runner), Clippy & Rustfmt, Build/Check all SUCCESS. Local verify.run deferred 10 times over ~3h due to host lease starvation, so CI is the authoritative evidence per the PM ruling. SPEC tasks updated with evidence and the descoped Broker routing split out as T-IDX-437a. Remaining: rebase onto PR #4185 (same acquisition loop) once it lands.
